<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/energy-drink-bottling-machine-inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MachineInspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_InspectionSetup" name="Begin inspection setup">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_EnterType</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineType" name="Enter machine type">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_EnterType</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterType_EnterSerial</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSerialNumber" name="Enter serial number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterType_EnterSerial</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterSerial_PresentQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PresentQuestions" name="Present inspection questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterSerial_PresentQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PresentQuestions_InputAnswers</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InputAnswers" name="Input inspection values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PresentQuestions_InputAnswers</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InputAnswers_PressButtons</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PressButtons" name="Press inspection buttons">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InputAnswers_PressButtons</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PressButtons_CollectValues</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectAndShowValues" name="Collect and display machine values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PressButtons_CollectValues</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectValues_DecideQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" name="Are additional questions required?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectValues_DecideQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalQuestions_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PresentAdditionalQuestions" name="Present additional questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalQuestions_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PresentAdditionalQuestions_Input</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InputAdditionalValues" name="Input additional values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PresentAdditionalQuestions_Input</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InputAdditionalValues_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions" name="Continue inspection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InputAdditionalValues_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InspectionComplete" name="Inspection complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_EnterType" sourceRef="StartEvent_InspectionSetup" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineType"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterType_EnterSerial" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineType" targetRef="Task_EnterSerialNumber"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterSerial_PresentQuestions" sourceRef="Task_EnterSerialNumber" targetRef="Task_PresentQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PresentQuestions_InputAnswers" sourceRef="Task_PresentQuestions" targetRef="Task_InputAnswers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InputAnswers_PressButtons" sourceRef="Task_InputAnswers" targetRef="Task_PressButtons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PressButtons_CollectValues" sourceRef="Task_PressButtons" targetRef="Task_CollectAndShowValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectValues_DecideQuestions" sourceRef="Task_CollectAndShowValues" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestions_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Task_PresentAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Inspection results require additional questions</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PresentAdditionalQuestions_Input" sourceRef="Task_PresentAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Task_InputAdditionalValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InputAdditionalValues_Merge" sourceRef="Task_InputAdditionalValues" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_End" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="EndEvent_InspectionComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
